text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to Master, Gran Alegria's training 
progressed smoothly.

We're conducting training that further 
develops and brings out her immense 
potential.
choice_data_list: (The problem is... "feel," huh.)
(The problem is... "feel," right.)

text_block_list.text:
A genius through and through, Gran Alegria 
has absolute confidence in her 
abilities—her legs and her "intuition".

However, if confidence turns to 
overconfidence and she runs recklessly 
like in that mock race... she could suffer 
an irreversible injury.

"To prevent that, I really need to 
understand her 'sensations'..."
choice_data_list:
(So even watching how she runs didn't 
work, huh)

(Even watching how she runs didn't work, 
did it)

text_block_list.text:
If analysis won't cut it... should I 
experience it firsthand? But I can't run 
like her...
choice_data_list:
(...Then, how about setting your own 
rules?)

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's pretty rare for you to join 
me for warm-ups!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I plan to keep accompanying you from 
now on, is that okay?

Yeah! I plan to keep accompanying you from

text_block_list.text: Of cooourse! A 100-miler is super welcome♪

『Don't stop! No, don't stop'til

text_block_list.text: Why are you practicing dancing, Trainer?!

text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so you're trying to experience 
Gran Alegria's personal rules 
firsthand..."

There's no other way to get a "feel" for

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it'll work. But we have to 
try everything we possibly can!

text_block_list.text:
In that case... why not watch her dance 
and try copying her?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own personal quirks 
when dancing. Perhaps it would be best to 
dance just like Gran Alegria?

text_block_list.text: Fufu... Trainer. Do your best!

understand.

curtain to rise— and striking the opening 
pose with a snap!

text_block_list.text: Phew! My rules!

"And then came the Asahi Hai FS— As usual, 
the radio was playing in the waiting 
room."

I couldn't help but feel that Gran Alegria 
seemed somewhat low on energy.
choice_data_list:
(Still, she seems to be focusing her mind, 
so...)

text_block_list.text:
For now, I placed the drink within her 
arm's reach and decided to leave the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Thank you for earlier!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Those 3 miles were great— my focus is 
really locked in!
choice_data_list: That's a relief!

text_block_list.text:
Many of her personal rules were aimed at 
keeping her mind centered, and seemed to 
follow a fixed routine. That's why I did 
my best not to get in her way.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I'm starting to get a feel for it, 
little by little!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, everyone's so fired up! I can't 
afford to lose either!

In the paddock, Gran Alegria was in her 
usual high spirits as ever.
choice_data_list:
(Being able to control it yourself is 
amazing)

(Being able to control it yourself is 
amazing, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go claim the title of our 
generation's Mile King!
